values.Example: The cruise ship stops at five islands.

values.Example: I booked two train tickets online.

values.Example: The guidebook recommends a small restaurant near the river.

values.Definition: nhà nghỉ giá rẻ, ký túc xá du lịch

values.Example: The tour guide told us about the history of the castle.

values.Example: Do not forget your passport at the airport.
